detail.title: Can Memories Alone Shape Preferences?
detail.question: Can a system develop preferences solely from accumulated memories and experiences?
detail.reason: Building on source-177acf3afcad4269, this project investigates if hippocampal-like computational mechanisms for preference formation emerge without explicit prior programming.
